## Read in datasets and count the tumor transgene markers
```{r transgene_read}
#| dependson: []
transgene_samples <-
    read_tsv(
        "misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv",
        show_col_types = FALSE
    ) %>%
    filter(sample_group == "truthset validation") %>%
    pull(Sample_ID) %>%
    unique()

roberts_transgene_samples <-
    read_tsv(
        "misc/mouse_samples_Roberts_realign_metadata.tsv",
        show_col_types = FALSE
    ) %>%
    pull(Sample_ID)

transgene_samples <- c(transgene_samples, roberts_transgene_samples)

sobj_list <- list()
for (this_sample in transgene_samples) {
    sobj_list[[this_sample]] <-
        qs::qread(paste0("output/seurat_objects/individual/", this_sample, "_mouse.qs")) %>%
        PercentageFeatureSet(pattern = "^tumor", col.name = "tumor_marker_pct")

    tumor_markers <-
        grep(
            "^tumor",
            rownames(sobj_list[[this_sample]]),
            value = TRUE
        )

    sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_marker_count <-
        FetchData(
            sobj_list[[this_sample]],
            vars = tumor_markers,
            layer = "counts"
        ) %>%
        rowSums()

    sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_cell <-
        if_else(
            sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_marker_count > 0,
            TRUE,
            FALSE
        )

    print(paste(this_sample, ":", mean(sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_marker_pct)))
    print(grep("^tumor", rownames(sobj_list[[this_sample]]), value = TRUE))
    print(table(sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_cell, sobj_list[[this_sample]]$seurat_clusters) %>% prop.table(margin = 2))
}

VlnPlot(sobj_list[["G0010"]], features = c("tumor_marker_pct", "tumor_marker_count"))
DimPlot(sobj_list[["G0016"]], group.by = "tumor_cell")
```

## Look at lineage tracing barcodes

```{r transgene_ltbc}
stuff <-
    tenx_load_qc(
        "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/Counts_2/S0261/filtered_feature_bc_matrix",
        violin_plot = FALSE
    ) %>%
    process_seurat()

ltbc_table <- gen_cellecta_bc_data(
    "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/Counts_2/S0260/possorted_genome_bam.bam",
    samtools_module = "GCC/9.3.0 SAMtools/1.10", verbose = TRUE
)

ltbc_sub <-
    ltbc_table %>%
    mutate(
        cid = paste0(cid, "-1"),
        barcode = paste0(lt_14, "_", lt_30),
        has_barcode = TRUE
    ) %>%
    select(-lt_14, -lt_30) %>%
    group_by(cid) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    column_to_rownames("cid")

stuff <-
    AddMetaData(
        stuff,
        ltbc_sub
    )

DimPlot(
    stuff,
    group.by = "has_barcode"
)
```
